crossRefs.note: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips.
Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.
All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”
I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe…
“In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he…
He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according…
We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his…
This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

translations.web: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.
translations.bsb: May He give you the desires of your heart and make all your plans succeed.
translations.kjv: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.
translations.asv: Grant thee thy heart's desire, And fulfil all thy counsel.
